Petiti
 Versus
 1. The State Of Bihar
2. Priti Rani Gupta D/o Ramesh Prasad Resident of Mohalla- Katra Chowk
(Gola Road), Shekhpura, P.S. and Distt- Shekhpura
Opposite Par

===== =
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Pramod Kumar Verma

For the Opposite party no. 2 Mr. Bipin Kumar
 Mr. Amarnath Kumar
 For the State : Mr. Shyam Kumar Singh
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
 Oral Order
3 06-01-2026 Heard learned counsel for the petitioner, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 and learned APP for the State.

2. The present application has been filed for quashing the order dated 16.05.2018 passed by the learned S.D.J.M., Sheikhpura in Complaint Case No. 480(C) of 2017 whereby and whereunder the learned S.D.J.M., Sheikhpura has taken cognizance under Sections 323, 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the D.P. Act.
3. The present case relates to a matrimonial dispute between the parties and it has been submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the petitioner is ready to amicably settle the Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.7567 of 2020(3) dt.06-01-2026 issues with the opposite party no. 2.
The learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 does have an objection towards an effort being made towards reaching such settlement.
4. In such view of the matter, with the consent of both the parties, let the matter be referred to the Mediation and Conciliation Centre of the Patna High Court.
5. At first instance, both sides agree to appear before the Mediation Centre on 19.01.2026 along with this order and other relevant documents.
Thereafter, Mediation Centre will fix further date.
